Your tasks

- As an experienced Fullstack Developer (all genders), you design and build scalable web applications as well as reusable components for our e-commerce, PIM, and CMS solutions. Occasionally, you'll liaise directly with clients on technical questions
- Depending on the project, you'll work with a modern tech stack including PHP (Symfony), Twig, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and Storybook
- Together with your development team, and in close collaboration with our design and conception colleagues, you continuously improve the user experience
- You build automated deployment solutions, reusable packages, tests, and interfaces to external integrations, driving our technical processes forward
- You value clean, maintainable code and find pragmatic, solution-oriented approaches to technical challenges

Your experience

- You bring experience in developing and maintaining web applications as well as component-based frontend development. You enjoy occasional client interaction
- You have several years of experience with a modern tech stack such as Node.js, TypeScript, React, Docker, and GraphQL, and are confident working with PHP and PHP-based frameworks like Symfony
- Solid knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL, along with confident use of Git, form the foundation of your work
- You're comfortable with CSS frameworks like Tailwind, templating languages like Twig, and building reusable UI components
- You're solution-oriented, reliable, and a strong team player, with very good English skills

Our benefits

Our employees should feel comfortable all the time. That's why we try to make the working environment as pleasant as possible.

- Mental Health: To support the mental health of our colleagues, we offer anonymous, free access to webinars and group sessions as well as individual consultations with coaches, psychologists or psychotherapists via the platform Nilo. Mental health is not a luxury, but the cornerstone of our happiness.
- Workation: valantic DXA offers you the possibility to use your mobile work quota also Europe-wide. For example, you can extend your vacation and your vacation feeling.
- Modern working environment: No matter where our employees work - at one of our 4 locations, in the home office or on the road - we attach great importance to the best hardware and a modern working environment. Our offices are equipped with the latest technology and we offer the support of an external service provider for home office equipment.
- Locations: If you want to manage modern projects, you can't squat in the last hole! All our offices are equipped with the latest technology and reflect the flair of the location.
- Teamevents: Numerous joint team events bring us all together again as a group, even if we work across Europe. From Christmas and summer parties, to joint activities and mountain festivals - there's a lot going on. Check out our Instagram channel for more insights.
- Corporate Benefits: At valantic DXA you can benefit from numerous offers and discounts at many companies. Simply register, browse and store. This applies to new shoes as well as gardening tools, vacations or the latest console...
- Mobile Work: Thanks to our flexible mobile work arrangement, you can work between 40 - 130 days per year outside your contracted work location, depending on your work model. Perfect for optimally combining job and family.
- Bike: With the JobRad program, you can put together the bike of your dreams and lease it from the dealer of your choice. The great thing about it is that the leasing amounts are deducted from your gross salary, thus optimizing your salary.
- Working environment: Noisy open-plan office with no decoration or opportunities for mental downtime? Not with us! At all our locations, we try to make the working environment as interesting, pleasant and inspiring as possible. And if you have a crazy idea for an improvement, let us know!
- Office Dog: It doesn't matter whether you can't organize care for your dog or need your four-legged friend as emotional support - everything is welcome here, from small to large. We offer you our own dog-friendly offices. There is only one iron rule: everyone cleans up their own mess...
- EGYM Wellpass (available only in Germany): With our EGYM Wellpass offer, you can get yourself up to operating temperature before work, strengthen your muscles during your lunch break or blow off steam in the evening. The EGYM Wellpass includes over 6000 studios throughout Germany.
- Flexible Working Hours: Yes, we have core working hours during which our chapters must be available. However, we can coordinate with each other and start later or finish earlier. Depending on what the current situation requires.
- Further Education: Acquiring new skills or deepening your knowledge to expert level is a prerequisite for us. To ensure that you continue to learn as much as possible, we offer you a wide range of opportunities. If it makes sense, it will be done!

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our team  of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

Location/Division Specific Information

Fisher Clinical Services GmbH is a subsidiary of Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. and is a market leader in Clinical Supply Chain Management Services and Clinical Supplies for patients worldwide.
You can find out more about our location in Weil am Rhein and Rheinfelden here: www.fisherclinicalservices.com

Discover impactful Work

Are you a PTA, PKA, CTA or have a comparable vocational qualification and would like to develop your career in pharmaceutical Quality Assurance?

Join our Quality Assurance team in Rheinfelden and support our Qualified Persons (QPs) in the certification and release of clinical trial materials for patients worldwide.

A university degree is not required for this position.

In this role, you will ensure that all required quality documentation is complete, compliant and available for timely batch certification and release.

Your responsibilities include:

- Preparing and reviewing documentation for QP certification and batch release

- Preparing Certificates of Release, Confirmations of Import and QP Declarations
- Verifying country-specific clinical trial approvals
- Maintaining QP tracking tools and compliant documentation records
- Supporting SOPs and other quality documents
- Supporting audits, inspections, investigations and CAPA activities
- Contributing to continuous improvement of our QA processes

- Experience in pharmaceutical Quality Assurance, Quality Control or another GMP-regulated environment is an advantage

- Structured and detail-oriented way of working
- Strong organizational and documentation skills
- Good communication and teamwork skills
- Fluent German and good English

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organization
- Outstanding career and development prospects

As a System Engineer you will be responsible for performing configuration, validation, deployment, and testing, of Airfield Lighting Control and Monitoring Systems (ALCMS).

The role involves delivering end-to-end customer projects, from supporting pre-sales and design to configuration, cabinet set up, testing and on-site commissioning. It is a cross-functional role that requires working with teams across the globe. The System Engineer has the opportunity to take ownership, solve problems and grow our business. ADB Safegate provides new System Engineers with extensive on-the-job training allowing them to become familiar with the applicable regulations and standards and reach a great understanding of the airfield lighting industry and product lines.

- Lead project lifecycle from production release to customer acceptance.
- Manage assigned milestones, deadlines and tasks.
- Interface with project engineers and customers to assist in software design, development, testing and troubleshooting.

Hardware

- Test and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools.
- Adhere to local and international safety and quality standards during testing and commissioning.

- Experience with Siemens PLC S7, TIA Portal or similar.
- Experience with network communication (Ethernet TCP/UDP) and fieldbus systems (Profibus, Modbus, CANbus, ProfiNET, etc).
- Experience with network configuration and hardware setup.
- Experience with AutoCAD drawings.

- Ability to work cooperatively in cross-functional, multiple geographic location setting.

This growth presents a unique set of challenges and opportunities, particularly in addressing the looming 50% capacity shortage by 2035. As a System Engineer at ADB SAFEGATE, we offer you the opportunity to work in a dynamic team focused on deploying systems pivotal to the global aviation industry's core operations.

About usNVision is innovating quantum technology with a unique approach - leveraging organic molecules to change lives for the better. Our platform spans from quantum signal enhancement that enables metabolic imaging today to quantum computing that could transform drug discovery tomorrow. Headquartered in Ulm, Germany, and backed by leading investors from the United States and Europe, we are now entering a phase of global commercialization and expansion.

With our POLARIS product line, we are extending the capabilities of standard MRIs to enable real-time metabolic imaging, transforming how diseases are detected, understood, and treated. Our work sits at the intersection of physics, engineering, chemistry, and medicine - translating cutting-edge science into clinical reality. Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a globally operating company and a leading provider of innovative metrology and process control solutions for semiconductor manufacturing.

With around 1,600 employees, 4 research and development centers, and 31 locations worldwide, we deliver valuable insights into the world’s most advanced industry. We leverage a variety of technological disciplines – including physics, optics, chemistry, and algorithms – to develop hardware and software solutions that measure virtually every modern computer chip in the world. Nova looks down to the atomic level, gains unique insights through dimensional, material, and chemical metrology, and provides customers with actionable data. This enables us to tackle critical challenges with differentiated solutions. Our exceptional, people-focused, and innovation-driven corporate culture ensures that every individual at Nova has the opportunity to make a real impact and push the boundaries of what is technologically possible.

Sentronics Metrology GmbH was recently acquired by Nova and is a leading company in the field of high-precision measurement solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. Based in Mannheim, Sentronics brings over 25 years of experience in developing state-of-the-art metrology systems. The integration of Sentronics is already well underway. Sentronics is now a permanent part of the Nova family and shares the same values: innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction. The combination of Nova’s global presence and Sentronics’ advanced technology and expertise create a unique platform for growth and innovation. As part of Nova, Sentronics will fully benefit from the exciting opportunities in the rapidly evolving semiconductor industry.

As Head of Product Marketing (m/f/d) at Sentronics Metrology (a Nova Company) in Mannheim, you will take on a key leadership role in driving the divisional product marketing strategy for our high-precision metrology solutions within the semiconductor industry. Your mission is to translate complex technological capabilities into clear market value, expand our footprint with key global customers, and lead the full product lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D, Sales, and Application teams.

We are looking for creative minds with high ambitions who see the seemingly impossible as a challenge and love to achieve innovative breakthroughs in a global, multidisciplinary team.

Please submit your application in English.

For questions, feel free to contact us at talents@novami.com (https://mailto:talents@novami.com) .

Responsibilities

- Leading divisional product management, marketing, and application development activities
- Driving the divisional product development lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D and Sales
- Developing and driving competitive positioning and value propositions to enable regional sales success
- Driving technical review meetings with key customers to expand Sentronics AP market share
- Representing Sentronics at global trade shows, including SEMICON, and delivering speaking engagements at technology conferences
- Aligning with internal and external stakeholders on customer demo development and execution
- ·Aligning cross-divisional segmentation strategies with other Nova divisions
- Acting as the primary representative of Sentronics/Nova across all company-wide marketing initiatives and events

Requirements

- Strong scientific background with at least a Master’s degree, preferably in Physics, Optics, or a related field
- 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 5 years in leading technical marketing/product management activities within the semiconductor WFE environment
- Deep, hands-on expertise in metrology requirements within semiconductor fabs
- Proven experience in working with key customers in the semiconductor industry (10B+ USD CapEx)
- Excellent Business-English communication skills, both verbal and written
- High willingness to travel internationally (up to 50%)

Benefits:

- Financial Wellbeing:  Receive a tax- and duty-free cash bonus of €100 per month to use flexibly through our discounts platform and with premium suppliers. Birthday gifts and other non-cash allowance bonuses are also included.
- Overall Wellbeing: Enjoy a free, generous breakfast with fresh fruit, a subsidized lunch, as well as free coffee, tea, and water. Take part in team events, company events, and volunteering activities.
- Flexibility & Time Off: Benefit from a hybrid work environment with flexible hours, remote work options, and flextime. You can also work up to 20 days per year from any country in Europe.
- Job Security: Work for a globally leading provider in the semiconductor industry that is continuously growing and focused on long-term success.
- Professional Development: Continuously develop your skills with individual training programs and our tailored learning platform.

Our Product Competence Center Esslingen is a key part of TK Elevator’s global innovation network.
